title: Normalization and simultaneous models for finite coefficient-system operations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and schemes $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On each small pro-etale site set $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$ for $n\ge1$ and $R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived category $\mathscr D_W=D(\mathscr S(B_{W,\bullet}))$ of whole semilinear systems, with its tensor and geometric inverse image [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. A normalized system has invertible transition adjoints $\alpha^A_{m,n}:q_W^*A_m\to A_n$, where $q_W^*=-\otimes^L_{B_{W,m}}B_{W,n}$, for all $m\ge n\ge1$, with the identity and quotient cocycles [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. For systems $A,N$ on $W$ and $C$ on $Y$, write $T_W(A,N)_n=A_n\otimes^L_{B_{W,n}}N_n$, $F_f(C)_n=Lf_n^*C_n$ for $f:X\to Y$, and $U_W=(B_{W,n}[0])_n$, with the induced whole-system transitions.

These whole-system operations preserve normalization, with precisely the following adjoint transition maps:
$$q_W^*T_W(A,N)_m\xrightarrow{\sim}q_W^*A_m\otimes^L_{B_{W,n}}q_W^*N_m\xrightarrow{\alpha^A_{m,n}\otimes\alpha^N_{m,n}}T_W(A,N)_n,$$
$$q_X^*Lf_m^*C_m\xrightarrow{\kappa^{-1}}Lf_n^*q_Y^*C_m\xrightarrow{Lf_n^*(\alpha^C_{m,n})}Lf_n^*C_n.$$
The first arrow in the first display is monoidal scalar extension. The coefficient square defining $\kappa$ commutes by the constant-section ring maps; $\kappa$ is the scalar-association map from $Lf_n^*q_Y^*$ to $q_X^*Lf_m^*$, whose inverse inserts $1$ in the intermediate scalar factor [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence]. The actual input transition factors as $C_m\to\operatorname{Res}q_Y^*C_m\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Res}\alpha^C_{m,n}}\operatorname{Res}C_n$; the displayed adjoints specify the actual output transitions, not a replacement by canonical scalar-extension units. On flat representatives the tensor adjoint sends $(a\otimes x)\otimes b$ to $\tau_A(a)\otimes b\tau_N(x)$. For $r\ge m\ge n$ both composite output adjoints agree with the direct one: the tensor formula uses the two input cocycles and $q_{r,n}=q_{m,n}q_{r,m}$, and both pullback scalar-association composites multiply the same three scalar factors and then use the input cocycle. The unit adjoint is $B_{W,m}\otimes^L_{B_{W,m}}B_{W,n}\cong B_{W,n}$.

All these comparisons and cocycles are constructed on whole systems before evaluation. Flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] may be chosen on the ringed sites; every finite iterated tensor or pullback, including coefficient-quotient pullback, is computed on such representatives by ordinary direct-sum total tensor and termwise inverse image. The resulting representatives remain flat-term K-flat, even for complexes unbounded in both directions; the simultaneous system models retain their transitions and coherence. No flatness of a quotient ring map is assumed.
